name: large-redesign-parallel-branch-collision-audit
description: Pre-flight audit before starting a large multi-PR redesign that rewrites shared files. Catches the failure mode where a long-running parallel feature branch (e.g. client-variant, staging, whitelabel) has unmerged commits touching the same files the redesign is about to rewrite — so they end up stranded with head-on conflicts that can't be cleanly cherry-picked. Sister to pre-merge-client-variant-regression-audit (audits a variant branch BEING merged into main; this audits BEFORE main diverges from a variant) and parallel-pr-scope-overlap-tiebreaker-delta-check (two simultaneous PRs vs. one redesign on main + WIP elsewhere). Companion to overnight-multi-issue-implementation for the file-collision dimension that the existing tracker-id audit doesn't cover.
